interpretation: Visible planes are recovered from monocular points. All corners share one orthogonal cuboid pose/shape model; occluded corners are completed by reprojection. Unobserved dimensions remain labelled hypotheses.

multiplane_refinement.principle: Retain only directly depth-supported visible faces, jointly align their union to the SAM instance silhouette, then refit one orthogonal metric cuboid with fixed-intrinsics PnP.
